pos.personaBrief: Ferguson's United often dominated with the ball (57% vs Marseille, FourFourTwo) yet scored on the counter from 1992-93 and set up to soak and counter vs Barcelona; possession is a means, not a creed.

pro.personaBrief: Meulensteen quotes him: think forward, play forward, break lines, pace and penetration; pace on the wings and quick counters, not slow circulation.

est.personaBrief: He denied playing a fixed 4-4-2, shifted shapes, let players express strengths and empowered them, with a deep second striker and Rooney dropping deep; fluid rather than rigid zones.

lar.personaBrief: Wingers (Kanchelskis, Sharpe, Giggs, Beckham, Ronaldo) were central to his attack, with full-backs overlapping and wingers running in behind per the 2008 briefing.

blo.personaBrief: He wanted to press really high and aggressively, with regain and retain, dropping into a block only at other times; deep sitting was situational in Europe.

mar.personaBrief: No marking source found; inferred from habit of assigning Park-type dedicated markers on stars and a pragmatic, clear-responsibility approach.

pla.personaBrief: Pragmatic adapter: nullified direct rivals, changed shape to mirror Chelsea, reshaped after Real Madrid 2000, flexible at half-time; but imposed his standards at arrival (1986 fitness, culls).

res.personaBrief: Winner above all (two trophies a season, 'battered them' stated), adding caution in Europe after 2000, while still wanting attacking pace and unpredictability.

sis.personaBrief: He empowered players to play to strengths, yet demanded defensive work from everyone (Rooney wide for diligence, Hargreaves wide) and no one bigger than the club.

jog.personaBrief: Pace, power, penetration with steel in midfield (Keane, Fletcher) and fitness overhaul in 1986; but technical passing drilled daily.

bas.personaBrief: Expanded youth system, nurtured Giggs, 'appetite for youthful enthusiasm', yet culled and bought top talent and won with experienced cores.

lid.personaBrief: Authority: culled Ince, Hughes, Kanchelskis, dropped Leighton, 'forget the nonsense about altering training programmes'; while claiming a caring side and unique harmony.
